assets.description: Three small white puffs of steam in a rising column, shown as a single-frame overlay above the character. Use for a supplied meal or drink explicitly described as hot or steaming. Does not animate eating, drinking, cooking or body movement.

A single yellow four-point sparkle overlay above the character for a brief moment of appreciation or noticing a detail. A static visual flourish; does not create rewards, change an object, or represent a personalised character action.

A small pink heart in a white rounded speech bubble above the character, suitable for a brief expression of liking or appreciation. Single-frame overlay only; does not establish a relationship or animate the character's body.

A single white camera-flash burst with short rays, displayed above the character. Use only when scene evidence or another supplied capability supports a camera moment. Contains no camera, phone, arm motion or personalised photo-taking pose.
